title: imap: credential_file secretx:// URI silently treated as filesystem path
description: imap build_credential_store calls merge_from_file even when credential_file starts with 'secretx:'. Reader has special-cased async secretx handling; imap does not. Operator who copies reader config with secretx URI to imap gets an I/O error opening a path named 'secretx://...' — confusing and the feature is silently broken.
